Usage: mcpjam cloud eval run [options]
Start an eval run of an existing suite, or upload a versioned suite file and run
it. The upload-and-launch has a 120s deadline overall, not per request (raise it
with the global --timeout <ms>); --wait-timeout bounds the RUN instead.
Options:
--suite <id-or-name> Eval suite name or ID
--file <path> Versioned suite file to upload and run (.yaml or .json, or - for stdin)
--project <id-or-name> Project name or ID (defaults to the most recently updated project)
--server <id-or-name...> Override the suite's saved server selection (HTTP servers only)
--environment <id-or-name...> Attached project environment(s) to run. Several values start one PAID RUN each.
--client <id-or-name...> Attached client(s) to run, so the run is stamped with that client's config. Several va
lues start one PAID RUN each.
--host <id-or-name...> Deprecated alias for --client. NOT the host-compat catalog id `mcpjam tools --host` ta
kes.
--all-targets Run EVERY attached environment (or, if none, every attached host) — one PAID RUN per t
arget
--iterations <n> Run each case this many times under verdict policy 2 (1-10)
--repetitions <n> Legacy spelling of --iterations
--case <id-or-title...> Run only these cases instead of the whole suite
--exclude-skills Run the 'without skills' arm: no skills are pinned, and the run is labelled as exclude
d
--refresh-snapshot PERSISTS a new host-config snapshot on the suite, changing every future run of it. Sin
gle-target runs only.
--notes <text> Free-text note stored on the run
--min-pass-rate <n> Pass threshold for this run (0-100)
--match-options <json> Tool-call match options for this run, e.g. '{"toolCallOrder":"exact"}'
--idempotency-key <key> Retry key for a lost launch response; for --file, one is minted and printed when omitt
ed
--wait Wait for every started run to reach a terminal status
--wait-timeout <ms> Maximum time to wait for completion (default 600000; a run held for its judge gets up
to 31 more minutes unless this flag is set)
--reporter <json-summary|junit-xml|html> Render the completed run report to stdout
--out <path> Atomically write the completed report selected by --reporter (default: json-summary)
--compose-client <id-or-name> Compose a stack to run instead of naming a saved environment: the client it runs as. D
efault is EPHEMERAL (does not attach to the suite).
--compose-host <id-or-name> Deprecated alias for --compose-client
--compose-computer <id-or-name> Sandbox image to pin on the composed stack
--compose-model <id...> Model(s) to run on the composed stack. Replaces the client default unless --with-clien
t-default is set.
--compose-model-selection <json...> A whole saved model selection (source, connection, settings.reasoningEffort) as JSON (
or @file, or -): one cell for its model, at its effort. Alongside --compose-model. Repeat it to add several selections for one mod
el (e.g. at low and at high) — each distinct selection is its own cell.
--with-client-default Also launch an inherit cell that uses each client's pinned model, alongside --compose-
model
--save-targets Attach the composed environments to the suite (append, capped at 10). Default is ephem
eral.
--compose-server <id-or-name...> Server(s) to pin on the composed stack. Snapshots them into a server group, so the run
keeps testing these servers even if the host's own server list changes later. Mutually exclusive with --compose-server-group.
--compose-server-group <id> Standalone server group to pin on the composed stack
--compose-host-servers No longer supported: eval runs take their servers from a server group. Use --compose-s
erver or --compose-server-group.
--compose-skill <id...> Project-shared skill IDs to pin on the composed stack
--compose-secret <id...> Project SECRET IDs the composed stack grants to its runs. Without one a composed stack
carries no credential — list them with `mcpjam secrets list`.
--allow-approximated <case...> Approve an `approximated` imported case for THIS RUN ONLY (authored case id). Repeatab
